title: File:U.S. Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel, left, meets with Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe at Sori Daijin Kantei, the prime minister's official residence, in Tokyo, April 5, 2014 140405-D-BW835-631.jpg
art: DOD photo by Erin A. Kirk-Cuomo
desc: U.S. Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel, left, meets with Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe at Sori Daijin Kantei, the prime minister's official residence, in Tokyo, April 5, 2014. Hagel and Abe discussed issues of mutual importance.

title: File:Prime Minister Takaichi meeting with President Milatović of Montenegro at Kantei on 22 April 2026 (12).jpg
desc:
On April 22, 2026, Prime Minister Takaichi held a meeting with H.E. Mr. Jakov Milatović, President of Montenegro, at the Prime Minister’s Office. 
Following a salute and guard of honor ceremony, the Prime Minister held a meeting with President Milatović.
